checks.name: single_breadth_formula_recorded
checks.detail: For each date, breadth = count(eligible assets with close > own 120-day SMA and own 20-day SMA > own 120-day SMA) / count(eligible assets).

checks.name: single_smoothing_rule_recorded
checks.detail: Smoothed breadth is a single causal 5-day EMA of the existing pure breadth ignition source ratio, using span=5, adjust=False, and min_periods=5.

checks.name: single_threshold_rule_recorded
checks.detail: Breadth ignition starts when the causal 5-day EMA crosses above the exact existing pure breadth ignition threshold of 2/3, and remains ON while that smoothed breadth stays above 2/3.

checks.name: single_volatility_measure_recorded
checks.detail: Slow BTC realized volatility is the 20-day rolling standard deviation of BTC daily returns annualized with sqrt(365), using min_periods=20.

checks.name: single_volatility_threshold_rule_recorded
checks.detail: The raw volatility hostility condition is true when slow BTC realized volatility is greater than its own 63-day rolling median multiplied by 1.20, using min_periods=63.

checks.name: ema_before_signal
checks.detail: breadth ignition cannot turn on before the smoothed breadth series has enough causal history

checks.name: volatility_veto_is_binary
checks.detail: volatility hostility veto is a binary state only

checks.name: volatility_veto_blocks_probe_risk
checks.detail: probe breadth risk never remains active when volatility hostility veto is active

checks.name: breadth_risk_only_on_baseline_cash_days
